paite: Huan Abimelek sih nung in Israelte hunkhe ding in Issakar mi Tola ahong dingkhia a; amah Puah tapa ahi. Puah bel Dodo tapa ahi. Amah Ephraim tanggam Shamir ah ateng hi.
heading: Tola
english: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

paite: Kum sawmnih-le-thum sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm a, huchi in asita a, Shamir ah avui uhi.
english: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

paite: Huai nung in Gilead mi Jair ahong dingkhia a, kum sawmnih-le-nih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: Jair
english: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.

paite: Ama'n sabiltungnou tung a tuang tapa sawmthum anei a, amau Gilead gam ah khua sawmthum anei ua, huaite tuni tan in Havothjair achi lai uhi.
english: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

paite: Jair asi a, Kamon ah avui uhi.
english: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou hih nawn in Baal leh Ashtaroth, Siriate pathian, Zidonte pathian, Moabte pathian, Ammon suante pathian leh Philistiate pathian nna asem uhi. Huchi in TOUPA alehngatsan ua, ama nna asemta kei uhi.
heading: Ammon Mite Nuaisiahna
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned Yahweh, and didn’t serve him.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta mahmah a, Philistiate leh Ammon suante kiang ah amaute akhawngta hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

paite: Huai kum in amau Israel suante hihbuai in anuaisiah uhi. Jordan gal Gilead gam a Amorte gam a Israel suan om tengteng kum sawm-le-giat sung anuaisiah uhi.
english: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

paite: Ammon suante bel Judahte, Benjaminte, Ephraim inkote dou ding in Jordan agalkah ua; huchi in Israelte alungzing mahmah uhi.
english: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

paite: Israel suante'n, "I Pathian in Baalte nna i na sep ziak un hon lehngatsanta, atung ah thil i hihkhialta uh," chi in TOUPA asam uhi.
english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Aiguptate a pan, Amorte a pan, Ammon suante a pan leh Philistiate a pan noute ka hon hunkhe kei maw?
english: Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

paite: Sidonte, Amalekte leh Ammonte'n leng noute ahon nuaisiah ua; na hon sam ua, huchi in akhut ua kipan ka hon hunkhia hi.
english: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.

paite: Himahleh noute'n na hon lehngatsan ua, pathian dangte nna na sem zawta uh. Huaiziak in ka hon hunkhe nawn kei ding.
english: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

paite: Na pathian telte uh samta unla, amau na gimthuak hun un hon hunkhia uhen," achi hi.
english: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhialta uh. Nang pha na sak bangbang in ka tung uah hih in. Himahleh ka hong thum uhi, tuni in hon hunkhe lai in," chi in.
english: The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”

paite: Huchi in alak ua namdang pathiante akoihmang ua, TOUPA nna asemta uh. Ama'n Israelte lungzinna athuakzou nawnta kei hi.
english: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

paite: Ammon suante akikhawm ua, Gilead gam ah ava kikulh ua, Israel suante leng akikhawm ua, Mizpah ah akikulh uhi.
english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.

paite: Mipite leh Gilead gam a miliante akihou ua, Ammon suante dou pan ding kua a-om a? Huai mi Gilead gam tengteng tung ah heutu ahi ding, akichi uhi.
english: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
